description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), removes positive effects, grants [Awoken Seraph], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)] and [Dystopian Shift] to the user

description.name: Awoken Seraph
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Dark and Holy abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Cross Shift after using a Dark or Holy ability

description.name: Cross Shift
description.text: Six single attacks (2.41 each), grants [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] and [Buff Holy 10% (15s)] to the user every second use

description.name: Buff Dark 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Dystopian Shift
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark] to the user after using two Holy or Dark abilities if the triggering ability dealt Holy/Dark damage

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%
